subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do workflow/security owners accept the fourteen upstream GitHub Action revisions, including the credential-bearing token, release, Docker, CodeQL, and Codex-agent workflows, for this repository’s trusted automation boundary?
rationale: The patch is a batch update of executable third-party workflow dependencies, several of which receive secrets or publish artifacts; that trust decision cannot be safely inferred from SHA pinning or ordinary CI alone.

options.title: Review and accept the Action revisions
options.body: Compare the upstream release diffs and provenance for the credential-bearing Actions, then merge after the required checks pass on the refreshed head.

options.title: Split or defer sensitive upgrades
options.body: Keep routine non-privileged Action bumps separate and defer the token, publish, or Codex-agent revisions until their owners complete a narrower review.

options.title: Pause this batch
options.body: Close or supersede the batch if its mixed security-sensitive surface is not worth reviewing as one Dependabot update.

recommendation.title: Review and accept the Action revisions
recommendation.body: Compare the upstream release diffs and provenance for the credential-bearing Actions, then merge after the required checks pass on the refreshed head.

likelyOwner.reason: It is the only available routing signal tied directly to this PR’s security classification; a human workflow/security owner should make the final decision.
